department: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by 1 December 2026 for Fall 2027 (Civil Engineering and Environmental Engineering PhDs); all materials, including official scores, must arrive by then or the file is not reviewed.
deadline.quote: The application deadlines are December 1 for the fall semester and August 1 for the spring semester. All materials must be submitted prior to the deadline. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: Do I need to take the GRE exam? The GRE is no longer required.

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for civil or environmental engineering.

supervisor.value: Not stated; faculty in the academic group you apply to make the admission and funding decisions, and you should name your research interests.

funding.value: Funding is mostly GRA/GTA (20 hours a week, stipend plus most tuition; average PhD GRA about USD 2,835 a month), decided by the faculty of your academic group; you request it in the application. The page does not say how many PhD admits are funded.
funding.quote: Nearly all funding from the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering is in the form of a research or teaching assistantship (GRA or GTA). | Ph.D. GRA: $2,835 per month

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD straight from undergraduate study; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Prospective students may apply for admission directly into the Ph.D. program from their undergraduate studies. Many Ph.D. students complete a master’s degree during the course of the doctoral program, but it is not required.

notes: Covers both CEE doctoral degrees (Civil Engineering; Environmental Engineering). The CEE FAQ says an English-medium degree does not by itself exempt you from TOEFL and points to the Graduate Education exceptions; under the Fall 2027 Institute rules a documented English-medium degree is one of those exceptions, so confirm with CEE.
name: PhD in Civil Engineering / PhD in Environmental Engineering
